items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the derived restriction functor of a K-flat differential graded algebra under base change, its commutation with the ground-ring derived tensor, and the representing module for K-flat inputs (statement lines 5720-5731). The proof (lines 5733-5780) does the real work on property-(P) modules: the canonical comparison map is shown to be an isomorphism with K-flatness simultaneously, by propagating both properties from the algebra through the sums of shifts, the split filtration (two-out-of-three lemma) and the filtered colimit (colimit K-flatness lemma). H2: the simultaneous induction over the property-(P) filtration is the argument; the passage from the claim to the three stated parts is the defining formalism of the derived tensor cited at the start.
